title: Concept: Go expvar endpoint served
description: The cmdline object is the process argument list. Services pass database URLs, signing keys and feature flags there more often than teams expect, and the memstats object confirms the runtime so the reader knows the output is live.
applicability: Responses from a Go service that imports net/http/pprof or expvar without removing the handler.
risk: The caller reads the process command line, which frequently contains credentials, and the runtime memory profile.
